set.body: Purpose: preserve the approved construction order as executable tracker state. Phase 0 establishes scientific trust; Phase 1 proves one narrow real-data psychology workflow; Phase 2 adds scientifically validated breadth; Phase 3 adds evidence-gated platform differentiators. The roadmap does not authorize publication or new breadth while the trust milestone is open. Exit criteria: each phase has explicit child acceptance criteria and blocking edges; deferred work remains non-blocking for the trust release; release evidence distinguishes local, hosted, and scientific validation.
set.title: Roadmap: trustworthy core to app-ready scientific platform
